title: Pole Offering
headline: Round and square straight poles sized for Solera solar area lights.
intro: Anchor-base and direct-burial poles from 10 to 30 ft, rated by EPA at 80 to 120 mph, with the mounting tenon and finish built into the part number.

tables.title: Round Straight | Anchor Base
notes: Max EPA is the largest effective projected area, in square feet, the pole carries at that wind speed.

Merged cells: 14 FT spans SL-RSP-14-3-11 and SL-RSP-14-4-11; 25 FT spans both 25-5 rows; 30 FT spans both 30-5 rows; Shaft Diameter 3.0 IN spans rows 8 FT through 14-3, 4.0 IN spans 14-4 through 20 FT, 5.0 IN spans all 25 FT and 30 FT rows; Wall Thickness 11 / Anchor Bolt 0.75 IN / Bolt Circle 8.5 IN span 8 FT through SL-RSP-25-5-11 and recur on SL-RSP-30-5-11; the 7-gauge rows (25-5-7, 30-5-7) carry 1.00 IN anchor bolts and a 10.0 IN bolt circle

footnotes: Anchor base poles: XX = mounting option, T2 = 2 3/8 in tenon, T2.5 = 2 7/8 in tenon, T3 = 3 in tenon
Direct burial poles: XX = mounting option, T2 = 2 3/8 in tenon, T2.5 = 2 7/8 in tenon (no T3 option for direct-burial poles)
YY = finish color: BK = Black, DB = Dark Bronze, GR = Gray

Product symbol key (foot of catalog page 69): dark square = OFF-GRID POST TOP LIGHT (SL-SPT); dark circle = OFF-GRID PATHWAY LIGHT (SL-CPT); dark triangle = OFF-GRID ALL-IN-ONE AREA LIGHT (SL-AIO-40L); yellow triangle = OFF-GRID ALL-IN-ONE AREA LIGHT (SL-AIO-70L); dark five-point star = OFF-GRID AREA LIGHT (SL-SAL-60L); yellow five-point star = OFF-GRID AREA LIGHT (SL-SAL-100L); dark cross = INTELLIGENT MODULAR AREA LIGHT (SL-MA1/SL-MA2); yellow cross = INTELLIGENT MODULAR DECORATIVE LIGHT (SL-MD1)
Max EPA headings (80), (90), (100) and (120) are wind speeds in mph
AS PRINTED (possible typo): SL-RPSQ-30-6-7-EMB-XX-YY Max EPA 17.9 / 11.7 / 8.3 / 8.3 versus 17.9 / 14.5 / 11.7 / 8.3 for the anchor-base version of the same pole
